sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Revenue reflects consolidated net revenue as reported in [[V.fact.revenue]]. Operating margin stands at [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] percent, indicating strong profitability. Return on average equity is [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] percent, highlighting robust earnings relative to equity. Debt‑to‑equity, including the current portion, is [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]] times, showing moderate leverage. Free cash flow amounts to [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] dollars, demonstrating healthy cash generation after capital spending. The price‑earnings multiple uses the close price from the dated price source [[V.price]] and diluted EPS for Class A common stock from [[V.fact.diluted_eps]]. Capex represents cash purchases of property, equipment and technology per [[V.fact.capex]]. All metrics are based on the fiscal year defined by the reporting periods in the source facts.

insight.text: Return on average equity remains exceptionally high, underscoring strong profitability relative to equity.
